job.job_description:
Python with Gen AI
At Capgemini, we work with the world as leading brands to enhance and transform the way they do business. We do this with passion and by applying the human touch to business and technology.


Job Description:
Responsibilities:


Develop and maintain Python-based applications and AI models.
Design and implement generative AI solutions for various business applications.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
Optimize and fine-tune AI models for performance and scalability.
Conduct research and stay updated with the latest advancements in generative AI.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to AI models and applications.
Document development processes and create technical documentation.


Core Competencies:


Proven experience in developing and deploying generative AI models.
Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms and frameworks.
Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.
Proficiency in data preprocessing and analysis.


Qualifications:


Bachelor's or master as degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
5+ years of experience in Python programming.
Exceptional analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities
Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex concepts to various audiences
Proven experience in developing and deploying generative AI models.
Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms and frameworks.
Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.
Proficiency in data preprocessing and analysis.
